title_en: Nvidia's unreleased RTX 3070 Ti 16GB comes to life thanks to a modder's crazy GDDR6 swap — Frankenstein card combines RTX 3070 PCB and new VRAM with RTX 3070 Ti GPU
title_zh: Nvidia未釋放的RTX 3070 Ti 16GB由於一個Moder瘋狂的GDDR6互換而復活——弗蘭肯斯坦卡結合了RTX 3070PCB和新的VRAM與RTX 3070 Ti GPU.
title_zcn: Nvidia未释放的RTX 3070 Ti 16GB由于一个Moder疯狂的GDDR6互换而复活——弗兰肯斯坦卡结合了RTX 3070PCB和新的VRAM与RTX 3070 Ti GPU.
title_ja: Nvidia の未発表 RTX 3070 Ti 16GB は、modder のクレイジー GDDR6 スワップのおかげで命に来ます — Frankenstein カードは RTX 3070 PCB と RTX 3070 Ti GPU の新しい VRAM を結合します
title_ko: Nvidia의 공개되지 않은 RTX 3070 Ti 16GB는 modder의 미적 GDDR6 스왑 덕분에 삶에 온다 - Frankenstein 카드 RTX 3070 PCB와 RTX 3070 Ti GPU와 새로운 VRAM을 결합
s_en: A modder has recreated the never-released RTX 3070 Ti with 16GB of VRAM using GDDR6 chips instead of the GDDR6X the retail 3070 Ti actually shipped with.
s_zh: 一臺調製器用GDDR6晶片而不是GDDR6X重製了從未發行的RTX 3070 Ti,其中16GB為VRAM,零售商3070 Ti實際配發.
s_zcn: 一台调制器用GDDR6芯片而不是GDDR6X重制了从未发行的RTX 3070 Ti,其中16GB为VRAM,零售商3070 Ti实际配发.
s_ja: モーダーは、GDDR6Xの代わりにGDDR6Xの小売3070 Tiが実際に出荷したGDDR6Xの代わりにGDDR6チップを使用してVRAMの16ギガバイトでリリースされていないRTX 3070 Tiを再作成しました。
s_ko: modder는 GDDR6X 대신 GDDR6X 소매 3070 Ti를 사용하여 GDDR6 칩을 사용하여 VRAM의 16GB와 결코 릴리스 된 RTX 3070 Ti를 재현했습니다.
content: A modder has recreated the never-released RTX 3070 Ti with 16GB of VRAM using GDDR6 chips instead of the GDDR6X the retail 3070 Ti actually shipped with.

s_en: OpenAI has made bold claims with its new GPT-6 Astra AI model, and it's certainly capable, but benchmarks suggest it has many of the usual weaknesses alongside the strengths, while cost and accessibility are still the biggest factors in widespread usage.
s_zh: OpenAI以其新的GPT-6 Astra AI模式提出了大膽的主張,它當然是有能力的,但基準顯示它除了優點外還有許多通常的弱點,而成本和無障礙仍然是廣泛使用的最大因素.
